title: סי' יז ויהי הם מריקים שקיהם
hebrewTitle: סי' יז ויהי הם מריקים שקיהם

segments.en: And this is what one prays: "and in Your holiness Your praisers give praise each day, Selah", etc. And this is what one prays: "and so sanctify Your Name" etc. — corresponding to the dimension of holiness above. And "and so grant Your fear" — corresponding to the dimension of honor above, the dimension of "to fear the honored Name." And afterward one prays "and so grant honor, G-d, to Your people" — that Israel too merit the honor above. And this is: "praise to those who fear You" — praise is the dimension of speech, as is explained in the main text. And "good hope," etc. — this corresponds to the dimension of Yetzira and Asiya, which are the dimension of the vessel for the letters Vav-Hay, as is explained in the Kavanos. This is the dimension of the Lower Unification — the dimension of Metatron which nests in Yetzira, etc.

segments.he: עיין לקוטי הלכות הלכות לולב הלכה ב' מבואר שם קצת איך שענין ר"ה ותקיעת שופר וסוכות ונטילת הד' מניים הכל סובב והולך על ענין המאמר הזה, הגם כי יש עוד לבאר בזה אעפי"כ אמרתי לקצר:
segments.en: And one must pray most for this unification — for "He will not enter the Jerusalem above until the Jerusalem below is established" — as the Sages, z"l, taught. And as is understood also in the main text: when the herbs sprouted, etc. — specifically then the Minister of the World said: "May the honor of G-d be forever." And this is "and the opening of speech for those who hope in You" — for specifically then the mouth and speech opens, as is understood in the main text. And this is "and joy for Your land", etc., and "the growth of the glory of David Your servant," etc. — for in this depends the redemption, as is understood in the main text.
